newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates largely higher.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates largely higher.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were largely higher on Tuesday as a result of the rise in Treasury bill rates at the auction, traders said.
A trader said the market continued to experience a rise in rates after the Central Bank raised late last week its overnight borrowing rate by 2.25 percentage points to 15 percent.
The Central Bank's move was intended to quell speculation against the peso following Thailand's financial woes.
